gloss: sound quality; tone quality; audio quality

definitions.gloss: sound quality; tone quality; audio quality
definitions.explanation: The quality or character of sound, especially as reproduced by audio equipment. Also used for the inherent tonal quality of musical instruments or voices.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ヘッドホン→ヘッドホン：04423_heddohon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{音質|おんしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: These headphones have good sound quality.

examples.japanese: {音質|おんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Where is the setting to adjust the sound quality?

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{音質|おんしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{期待|きたい}していた→期待する：06065_kitaisuru⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{良|よ}かった→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: The price was cheap, but the sound quality was much better than I expected.

notes:
Composed of {音|おん} (sound) + ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (quality). Very commonly used when discussing audio equipment, music streaming, recordings, and musical instruments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音質|おんしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: good/bad sound quality
- ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧{音質|おんしつ}: high sound quality
- {音質|おんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧: to adjust sound quality
- {音質|おんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to be particular about sound quality
- {音質|おんしつ}⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧: improvement in sound quality
